item.title: AniShot 0.17.1
item.description: Adds voluntary diagnostic reports with a visible optional comment. Confirmed sending shows a thank-you screen; OK closes Settings. Screenshots are excluded from diagnostics. Development testing download; not notarized.

item.title: AniShot 0.15.0
item.description: One Universal download with native Intel and Apple silicon code. Redesigned drag-to-Applications installer with large icons and a directional arrow. Requires macOS Sonoma 14 or newer. Real Intel hardware testing remains pending; this development version is not notarized.

item.title: AniShot 0.14.1
item.description: Fixes Edit Extensions opening sharing settings while preserving the capture. Simplifies Share to a native menu without the preview header. Compatible installed sharing extensions remain available. Apple silicon development version; not notarized.

item.title: AniShot 0.11.1
item.description: Fixes size controls for Text and Pixelate at small panel sizes and rapid clicks. The former 80% panel size is now 100%. Adds a full-width centered size field, wider bold minus/plus buttons, larger action labels and larger hints. Apple silicon development version; not notarized.
